verdict.rationale: Sumsub is an identity-verification vendor that runs biometric Liveness and face-match checks, so documentation on lawful biometric processing is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains nothing on GDPR lawful bases, BIPA or other US biometric statutes, or recommended consent language. The SDK text customization and Liveness docs describe features, not legal handling, so they do not deliver this story.
